            v4.0 APEX — STRICT RULE COMPLIANCE & ADVANCED FALKORDB APIS
            
Hybrid HNSW Vector+Graph Index, Unstructured Entity Ingestion, Bus-Factor Centrality & 4-Agent BFT Quorum

            
Showcases FalkorDB's deepest native capabilities: db.idx.vector.queryNodes, algo.betweenness, live text-to-Cypher MERGE extraction, and weighted swarm consensus.

          

          

            Org Resilience Score: 78%
          

        


        

          
          

            

              1. Hybrid HNSW Vector + 3-Hop Cypher (db.idx.vector.queryNodes)
              2.12 ms (HNSW + 3 Hops)
            

            

              Unlike flat vector DBs that stop at text chunks, FalkorDB fuses HNSW vector similarity (vecf32) with multi-hop graph expansion in a single atomic query.
            

            

              
              
            

            
CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Document', 'embedding', 3, vecf32($query_vec))
YIELD node AS doc, score
MATCH (doc)-[:DOCUMENTS]->(sys:System)<-[:MODIFIED]-(pr:PullRequest)
OPTIONAL MATCH (owner:Person)-[w:WORKED_ON]->(sys)
RETURN doc.id, score AS cosine, sys.name, sys.pagerank, pr.id, owner.name
